title: Understand the Structure:
text_preview: -Babylonian numbers are written in a positional system similar to our decimal system but based on 60. Each position represents a power of 60.

title: Analyze the Given Symbols:
text_preview: -The symbols are written as . This suggests two separate groupings, which can be interpreted as two different positional values.

title: Convert Each Group:
text_preview: -The first symbol (8) is in the higher position, so it represents 8 × 60 = 480. -The second group (50 + 6) represents 56.

title: Calculate the Total:
text_preview: -Add the values from each group: 480 + 56 = 536.Therefore, the Sumerian cuneiform symbols convert to the Arabic numeral 536.
